target_source: interval-online metadata gradient boosting refit with the current-day post-gate arrivals masked before feature construction

causal_reserve_planning.interpretation: The empirical reserve is a pre-gate planning envelope. It can reserve capacity for future arrivals, but the event-gate payment profile is solved on the committed ledger and cannot credit the reserved jobs before a later commitment checkpoint.

scoring_source: locked trace-anchored execution and semi-synthetic response
meter_cap_scoring_note: For the locked audit, the trace-anchored no-event profile is used only after the event to score the meter-capped settlement rule; it is not supplied to target fitting, gate decisions, or any workload optimization. Production deployment substitutes a precommitted no-event contract profile.

committed_ledger_safe_mode.certificate_scope: committed-ledger service feasibility; all paid service is committed at the gate
committed_ledger_safe_mode.settlement_rule: meter-capped-after-event; gross forecast credit is not paid above the pointwise metered response

protocol_note: The truncated profile is an information-boundary diagnostic. The committed-ledger profile is the deployable rolling-service mode; the complete-ledger comparator quantifies the value of post-event information.
